distribution.summary: 陕西；陕西（未确认）；山西（未确认）
distribution.narrative: Johnson et al. (2020) could not corroborate Shaanxi or Shanxi records and notes that earlier northern-China reports were partly confused with C. scopiger. Chinese occurrence remains unconfirmed.

host_note: Viburnum dilatatum is retained only as a questionable historical host for China.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus viburni Stark, 1936.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus viburni
